responsibility: This module is GCC’s core GIMPLE middle-end subsystem: it defines the GIMPLE intermediate representation itself, lowers front-end GENERIC trees into High and then Low GIMPLE, provides the APIs and utilities for constructing, validating, traversing, editing, printing, and streaming GIMPLE/SSA code, and hosts many canonical statement- and SSA-level analyses, optimizations, hardening passes, and diagnostics that operate on that IR. Its major file families cover the IR definition and builders (gimple.*, gimple.def, gimple-expr*, gimple-builder*, gimple-iterator*, gimple-walk*, gimple-pretty-print*, gimple-streamer*), tree-to-GIMPLE lowering and regimplification (gimplify*, gimple-low*, gimple-lower-bitint*), simplification and pattern matching (gimple-fold*, gimple-match*), SSA support and transformations (gimple-ssa*, EVRP, copy/strength/store/path/loop and CRC-related passes), the ranger value-range framework and its cache/edge/GORI/path/PHI/inference components (gimple-range*), plus GIMPLE-based warning and hardening passes for bounds, access, recursion, restrict, alloca, nonnull, and control-flow integrity. Together these files distinguish the module as the shared IR, lowering, analysis, and transformation layer that most language-independent GCC middle-end work is built on.
